x-e-e6-03.topic: Yanke hukunci kan ikirari da hujja
x-e-e6-03.title: Kungiyar karatu ta yi nasara? Canza hukuncinka yayin da shaida take ƙaruwa.
x-e-e6-03.goal: Yayin da ake ƙara bayanai ɗaya bayan ɗaya, canza hukuncinka game da iƙirarin “ƙungiyar karatu ta yi nasara”, sannan ka kammala da Turanci ta amfani da shaidu guda biyu.
x-e-e6-03.material: An fara sabuwar kungiyar karatu a makarantarmu. Malami ya ce, “Kungiyar ta yi nasara.” Za ka samu shaidun ɗaya bayan ɗaya, kana tunanin ko wannan magana daidai ce.
x-e-e6-03.thinking.0: Kada ka yanke hukunci daga shaida guda ɗaya kawai.
x-e-e6-03.thinking.1: Canza hukuncinka idan sabon bayani ya bayyana.
x-e-e6-03.thinking.2: Rubuta iƙirari ta hanyar haɗa shaidu da dama.
x-e-e6-03.prereq.1: Furuci masu sauƙi kamar sign up, only, come.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.prompt: Duba bayanan ɗaya bayan ɗaya, sannan kowane lokaci ka zaɓi ra’ayinka game da maganar “Kungiyar ta yi nasara”.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.hint.0: Bambance abin da bayanin yanzu ya tabbatar da abin da har yanzu ba ka sani ba.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.hint.1: Kwatanta ko sabon bayanin yana nuna alkibla iri ɗaya da na baya ko akasin haka.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.info: A March, ɗalibai 12 sun yi rajistar shiga kungiyar.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.ask: Daga wannan bayani kaɗai, yaya za ka fahimci maganar “Kungiyar ta yi nasara”?
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.after: Yawan waɗanda suka yi rajista shaida ce ta fara aiki. Dole ne ka ga yadda suka shiga cikin ayyukan daga baya.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.o.a: Kungiyar ta yi nasara. 12 adadi ne mai yawa.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.r.a: Wannan ya yanke ƙarshe daga yawan rajista kawai. Har yanzu ba mu san abin da suka yi bayan rajista ba.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.o.b: Ba ta yi nasara ba. Kungiyoyi ba su da farin jini koyaushe.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.r.b: Wannan ya yanke ƙarshe daga magana ta gama-gari da ba ta cikin bayanan.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.o.c: Har yanzu ba mu sani ba. Yin rajista farkon abu ne kawai.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.0.r.c: Wannan yana bayyana iyakar shaidar da muke da ita yanzu.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.info: A taron May, ɗalibai 4 ne kawai suka zo.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.ask: Yanzu akwai ƙarin bayanai. Yaya kake ganinta yanzu?
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.after: Dalibai da yawa sun yi rajista amma kaɗan ne suka zo. Shaidar “nasara” ta yi rauni, amma har yanzu ba mu san dalilin da yawan ya ragu ba.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.o.a: Lambar farko ce ta fi muhimmanci, saboda haka ta yi nasara.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.r.a: Wannan ya daidaita sabon bayanin da hukuncin farko.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.r.b: Wannan ya rage ƙarfin hukunci ta hanyar haɗa bayanai biyun.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.1.r.c: Babu ma’aunin abin da ake kira “kaɗan”, amma duk da haka an yi saurin yanke ƙarshe.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.info: Waɗanda suka zo 4 sun karanta littattafai 3 kowane wata kowannensu. A halin yanzu, ɗalibai 6 sun koma kungiyar wasanni da take haɗuwa a lokaci ɗaya.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.ask: Yanzu, wane tunani ne ya fi dacewa?
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.after: Attendance ya ragu, amma ɗaliban da suka halarta sun karanta littattafai da yawa, kuma raguwar na iya kasancewa saboda lokutan sun zo daidai. Dole ne mu ƙara bincike kafin mu yanke ƙarshe.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.o.a: Ya ragu ne domin kungiyar karatu tana da ban sha’awa kaɗan.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.r.a: “Ba ta da ban sha’awa” dalili ne da ba ya cikin bayanan.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.o.b: Ɗaliban da suka zo sun karanta sosai, kuma raguwar na iya kasancewa saboda lokutan sun zo daidai. Ya kamata mu ƙara tambaya.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.r.b: Wannan yana bambance gaskiyar da ke cikin bayanai da abin da har yanzu ba mu sani ba.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.o.c: Waɗanda suka yi ƙoƙari su ne 4 da suka zo kawai, saboda haka kungiyar ta yi nasara.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.st.2.r.c: Wannan yana yanke hukunci game da kowa daga sakamakon wasu ɗalibai kaɗan kawai.
x-e-e6-03.s.s1.reflect: Da farko abin ya yi kama da “nasara”, amma hukuncinka ya canza duk lokacin da sabuwar shaida ta bayyana. Dole ne ka iya canza hukuncinka yayin da ake ƙara shaida.
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta jimlolin Turanci ɗaya ko biyu. Bayyana ra’ayinka ko kungiyar karatu ta yi nasara, sannan ka haɗa shaidu biyu daga bayanan da ke sama.
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.hint.0: Da farko ka rubuta ra’ayinka a jimla guda. (I think / I am not sure ...)
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.hint.1: Yi amfani da but domin haɗa shaida ta biyu (ɗaya daga attendance, littattafai, ko kungiyar wasanni).
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: I am not sure ... because ...
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka yi amfani da shaidu biyu dabam-dabam (rajista / halarta, da sauransu)?
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.selfAssess.2: An danganta kowace shaida da matakin bayanan da ya dace?
x-e-e6-03.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta bayyana wani ɓangare na nasara tare da iyakokinta.

x-e-e6-04.topic: Yanke hukunci kan ikirari da hujja
x-e-e6-04.title: Ƙirƙiri jadawalin zaɓe domin nemo yanayin da iƙirarin yake gaskiya.
x-e-e6-04.goal: Ƙirƙiri jadawalin ƙuri’a da dama da kanka inda iƙirarin Turanci “ya samu ƙuri’u mafi yawa amma ba rabin ajin ba” yake gaskiya.
x-e-e6-04.material: Ɗalibai 20 na aji kowannensu ya zaɓi aiki guda ɗaya bayan lokacin ciye-ciye: ƙwallon ƙafa, zane, ko kiɗa. Ana kiran ƙuri’un s (ƙwallon ƙafa), a (zane), da m (kiɗa).
x-e-e6-04.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri misalai da suka cika sharudda da dama lokaci guda.
x-e-e6-04.prereq.1: Ma’anonin mafi yawa, ƙasa da, da rabi.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.prompt: Sakamakon ya kasance ƙuri’u 8 ga ƙwallon ƙafa, 6 ga zane, 6 ga kiɗa. Wace jimla ce ta fi bayyana shi daidai?
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.0: Haɗa 8, 6, da 6, nemo rabin ɗalibai 20, sannan ka kwatanta.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.hint.1: Ka kwatanta abin da “mafi yawa” da “kowa” suke nufi.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.a: Bincika ko an tabbatar da sharuddan biyu da lambobi.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.r.c: Sake kwatanta ko 8 ya fi ko ya ƙasa da 10.
x-e-e6-04.s.s1.explain: Ƙuri’u 8 sun fi na zane (6) da kiɗa (6), saboda haka su ne mafi yawa; kuma sun ƙasa da 10, rabin 20, don haka ba rabinsu ba ne. Saboda haka a ce ta dace.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.prompt: Ƙirƙiri jadawalin ƙuri’a 3 dabam-dabam na jimillar ɗalibai 20 inda iƙirari ɗaya (“ƙwallon ƙafa ya fi ƙuri’u, amma bai kai rabi ba”) yake gaskiya.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.0: Dole ne ƙwallon ƙafa ya samu mafi yawa, saboda haka ka fara da zaɓar ƙima da ta fi ta zane da kiɗa.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.hint.1: Kayyade ƙuri’un ƙwallon ƙafa a ƙima guda, sannan ka cire daga 20 ka raba sauran tsakanin zane da kiɗa. Idan ƙuri’un ƙwallon ƙafa sun yi ƙasa sosai, ba za ka iya kaiwa jimillar 20 ba.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c1: Ƙuri’u cikakkun lambobi ne 0 ko fiye.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c1: Rubuta ƙuri’u a matsayin cikakkun lambobi 0 ko fiye.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c3: Ƙwallon ƙafa ce ta fi ƙuri’u.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c3: Ƙwallon ƙafa ba ta fi ƙuri’un zane ko kiɗa ba.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.ok.c4: Ƙwallon ƙafa ba ta kai rabin ƙuri’u (ƙuri’u 10) ba.
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.fail.c4: Ƙwallon ƙafa ta kai aƙalla rabin ƙuri’u (ƙuri’u 10).
x-e-e6-04.s.s2.explain: Domin ƙwallon ƙafa ta fi ƙuri’u, dole ne zane da kiɗa kowannensu ya sami ƙasa da s, kuma jimillarsu 20-s ce. Idan s=7, to a+m=13, saboda haka ba za su iya zama 6 ko ƙasa da haka duka ba, sharadin bai cika ba; idan s ya kai 10 ko fiye, ya zama rabi. Don haka s na iya zama 8 ko 9 kawai.

Lura: wurin da aka saba shi ne bencin ƙarƙashin babban bishiyar da ke gefen filin wasa, kayan kuma ƙwallo da kwalaben ruwa ne.

x-e-e6-06.thinking.1: Nemo zato biyu da ke bayan iƙirarin.

x-e-e6-01.title: Tsara dalilan riƙe dabbar aji.
x-e-e6-01.topic: Ɗan gajeren rubutu da ra’ayi mai sauƙi.
x-e-e6-01.goal: A cikin rubutun ra’ayin Jin, bambance ra’ayin kansa, dalilai, misalan da suke zama shaida, da furucin da bai shafi batu ba; sannan ka yanke hukunci da Turanci kan wane dalili ne ya fi ƙarfi.
x-e-e6-01.material:
Aji 6-3 yana tattaunawa game da “Ya kamata mu riƙe dabbar aji?” Ga rubutun Jin.

I think we should get a class pet. A pet can teach us to take care of animals. I like cats very much, and I want to see one every day. Class 6-1 had a fish last year, and students fed it by turns. Also, many students are afraid of dogs.
x-e-e6-01.thinking.0: Bambance ra’ayi da dalilan da suke goyon bayansa.
x-e-e6-01.thinking.1: Bambance ɗanɗanon mutum da shaida da za a iya tantancewa.
x-e-e6-01.prereq.0: Za ka iya gane furucin ra’ayi kamar I think ~ / because.
x-e-e6-01.prereq.1: Kalmomi masu sauƙi kamar fish, pet, feed.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi kowace jimla da take dalili na goyon bayan ra’ayin Jin “ya kamata mu riƙe dabbar aji”.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.hint.0: Ga kowace jimla, tambayi kanka ko tana taimaka wa iƙirarin cewa duk ajin ya kamata ya riƙe dabba.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.hint.1: Bambance jimlolin da suke nuna jin mai magana kawai, kamar “I like ...”, da hujjojin da wasu za su iya tantancewa.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.a: Wannan jimla tana magana ne game da amfanin da zai samu ga aji. Ka kuma kwatanta da ra’ayin: maimaita abu ɗaya ne kawai?
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.b: Ka yi tunani ko ɗanɗanon mai magana dalili ne ga dukkan ajin.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.c: Wannan jimla tana amfani da abin da ya faru da gaske a matsayin misali. Ka yi tunani yadda yake haɗuwa da iƙirarin.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.d: Yanke hukunci ko wannan dalili ne na riƙe dabbobi gaba ɗaya, ko damuwa ne game da wasu dabbobi kawai.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.r.e: Duba ko wannan jimla dalili ce ko iƙirarin kansa.
x-e-e6-01.s.s1.explain: a dalili ne da ya ambaci amfanin riƙe dabba, c kuma shaida ce domin misali ne da wani aji ya gwada da gaske. b ɗanɗanon Jin ne kawai, ba dalilin da ajin yake bukata ba. d yana magana ne game da rashin son wasu dabbobi, e kuma ba dalili ba ne, iƙirarin kansa ne.
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta jimloli ɗaya ko biyu ga Jin da Turanci. Faɗi wanne daga cikin dalilansa ya fi ƙarfi, sannan ka bayyana dalilinka (ko ka faɗi ƙarin abin da ake bukata).
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi dalili guda mai ƙarfi, sannan ka ɗauki kalma ɗaya ko biyu daga jimlar domin amfani da su a amsarka.
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.hint.1: Yi amfani da because ko so domin haɗa “dalilin da ya sa yake da ƙarfi”.
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Ka faɗi jimlar rubutun Jin da dalilin da ka zaɓa yake ciki?
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa wannan dalili yake da ƙarfi (ko ƙarin abin da ake bukata)?
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Ka yanke hukunci kan dalilan ga dukkan ajin, ba bisa ɗanɗanon kanka ba? (na zaɓi)
x-e-e6-01.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta nuna raunin dalili (ba shi da misali).

x-e-e6-02.title: Gyara sassan imel ga malami da ba su dace da juna ba.
x-e-e6-02.goal: Nemo inda layuka biyu na imel ba su dace da juna ba, sannan ka sake rubutawa da Turanci domin shirin ya yiwu.
x-e-e6-02.material: Yuna za ta aika wa malaminta, Mr. Park, imel game da taron rukuni don aikin gida na kimiyya. Za a iya amfani da laburare har ƙarfe 5 na yamma a Thursday.
x-e-e6-02.thinking.1: Kwatanta gyare-gyare masu yiwuwa: wane layi za a iya canzawa?
x-e-e6-02.thinking.2: Bincika ko gyararren jimla ta dace da sauran layuka.
x-e-e6-02.prereq.1: Furuci masu sauƙi kamar can, want to, after.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.prompt: Zaɓi layi guda a imel ɗin da bai dace da sauran layuka ba, saboda haka taron ba zai yiwu ba.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.hint.0: Sanya lokacin taro kusa da lokacin da ɗaya daga cikin membobin rukuni zai iya zuwa, sannan ka kwatanta su.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.hint.1: Rubuta ranar da lokacin kowane layi, har da a.m./p.m.
x-e-e6-02.s.s1.explain: Layi na 3 ya ce a haɗu da 3 p.m. a Thursday, layi na 4 kuma ya ce Mina za ta iya zuwa ne kawai bayan 4 p.m., saboda haka layukan biyun ba su dace ba. Za ka iya gyara lokacin haɗuwa (layi na 3) ko canza yanayin Mina (layi na 4); za mu karɓi duk layin da ka zaɓa.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.prompt: Sake rubuta layi na 3 da Turanci domin taron ya yiwu. Dole ne ka kuma yi la’akari da cewa za a iya amfani da laburaren har zuwa 5 p.m. kawai.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.hint.0: Zaɓi lokacin haɗuwa tsakanin farkon lokacin da Mina za ta iya zuwa da lokacin da laburare zai rufe.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.hint.1: Za ka iya canza ranar maimakon lokacin. Idan ka yi haka, bincika ko layi na 4 har yanzu ya dace.
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.placeholder: Misali: Our group wants to meet...
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Lokacin da ka gyara yana bayan lokacin da Mina za ta iya zuwa (ko ka canza ranar)?
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Gyararren jimlarka ya dace da ƙa’idar laburare ta 5 p.m. da layi na 4 duka?
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Gyararren jimlarka tana haɗuwa da sauran layukan imel ɗin yadda ya dace?
x-e-e6-02.s.s2.modelNote.1: Amsa ce da ta canza ranar, kuma ta sa layin dalili ya dace ma.

x-e-e6-05.title: Laima guda ɗaya mai jika za ta iya gaya mana “ana ruwa yanzu”?
x-e-e6-05.topic: Zato da aka ɓoye a cikin iƙirari mai sauƙi.
x-e-e6-05.goal: Nemo zato da taƙaitaccen dalilin Mia yake ɗauka a matsayin gaskiya ba tare da faɗa ba, sannan ka ƙirƙiri yanayi da Turanci inda wannan zato ba gaskiya ba ne.
x-e-e6-05.material: Mia ta ce, “Dan ya shigo aji da laima mai jika. Saboda haka ana ruwa a waje yanzu.”
x-e-e6-05.thinking.0: Nemo zatonta da ba ta bayyana ba.
x-e-e6-05.thinking.1: Ƙirƙiri yanayin da zai zama misali mai karyatawa ga zato.
x-e-e6-05.thinking.2: Bayyana sharuddan da iƙirarin yake aiki a ƙarƙashinsu.
x-e-e6-05.prereq.0: Kalmomi masu sauƙi kamar wet, rain, outside.
x-e-e6-05.prereq.1: Za ka iya karanta dalilan da aka haɗa da because/so.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.prompt: Wane tunani ne Mia ba ta faɗa ba amma dole ne ta yi imani da shi, domin “ana ruwa a waje yanzu” ya biyo daga bayaninta?
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.hint.0: Ka koma baya mataki-mataki daga ƙarshe da Mia ta yanke, ka gani abin da ake bukata domin “laimar ta jike” ta zama “ana ruwa yanzu”.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.hint.1: Bambance gaskiyar da aka riga aka rubuta a rubutun da tunanin da ba a rubuta ba.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.a: Wannan gaskiya ce da tuni take cikin rubutun. Bincika ko zato ce da aka ɓoye.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.b: Wannan amfani ne na laima gaba ɗaya. Ka yi tunani ko wannan alaƙa ce da dalilin ke bukata da gaske.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.c: Wannan yana magana game da alaƙar da ke kai daga “jike” zuwa “ana ruwa yanzu”.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.r.d: Wannan yanayi ne da tuni aka rubuta a rubutun.
x-e-e6-05.s.s1.explain: Domin a ce laimar ta jike saboda ana ruwa yanzu, ana bukatar zato cewa babu wani dalili dabam. Laima na iya jike ko da ruwan ya daina, idan an wanke laimar ko ta faɗa cikin ruwa.
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.prompt: Rubuta jimla guda da Turanci game da yanayin da ƙarshe da Mia ta yanke ba daidai ba ne. Faɗi dalilin da ya sa laimar take jike amma ba a ruwa yanzu ba.
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin abubuwan da ba ruwan sama ba da suke jika laima. (ruwa, lokaci, wuri)
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.hint.1: Yanayi na wani lokaci dabam ma yana yiwuwa, kamar “Ruwan sama ya riga ya daina.”
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.0: A yanayin da ka rubuta, laimar tana jike amma ba a ruwa yanzu?
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.1: Ka ga dalilin da ya sa imanin Mia (babu wani dalili dabam) ba daidai ba ne?
x-e-e6-05.s.s2.selfAssess.2: Yanayin yana da yiwuwa a zahiri?

x-e-e6-07.title: Rubuta amsa da ladabi domin ƙin gayyatar ranar haihuwar aboki.
x-e-e6-07.goal: Tsara abubuwan da amsar ƙin gayyata take bukata (godiya, ƙin a sarari, dalili, wani shawara), sannan ka rubuta da kanka da Turanci.
x-e-e6-07.material:
Abokinka Sam ya aiko da saƙo.

Hi! Can you come to my birthday party on Saturday at 2 p.m.? It is at my house. Please tell me by Wednesday.

Amma kana da tafiyar iyali a Saturday, saboda haka ba za ka iya zuwa ba. Ga daftarin amsarka na farko: “I can't come to your party. Bye.”
x-e-e6-07.thinking.0: Kwatanta ƙin gayyata marar bayani da bayyananne.
x-e-e6-07.thinking.1: Zaɓi abubuwan da suke kula da yadda ɗayan zai ji.
x-e-e6-07.thinking.2: Rubuta da kanka ta hanyar dacewa da mai karatu.
x-e-e6-07.prereq.0: Furuci kamar can’t / thank you for ~.
x-e-e6-07.prereq.1: Kalmomi masu sauƙi kamar Saturday, next week.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.prompt: Waɗanne gyare-gyare za su taimaka wajen mayar da daftarin da ke sama amsa mafi kyau ta ƙin gayyatar? Zaɓi duk waɗanda suka dace.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.hint.0: Ka yi tunanin yadda Sam zai ji idan ya karanta, sannan ka nemo abin da ya ɓace a daftarin.

x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi la’akari da cewa Sam dole ne ya yanke shawara game da amsar kafin Wednesday.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.b: Wannan aiki ne da ya fara nuna damuwa da yadda ɗayan yake ji.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.c: Ka kwatanta yadda ɗayan yake ji idan an bayar da dalili da idan babu dalili.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.r.d: Wannan hanya ce ta ci gaba da kyakkyawar alaƙa bayan ƙin gayyata.
x-e-e6-07.s.s1.explain: Fara da godiya da ba da shawarar wata rana yana sa ƙin gayyatar ya yi ƙasa da sanyi. “Maybe” yana sa Sam ya kasa shirya abubuwa, barin dalili kuma na iya zama kamar rashin kulawa.

x-e-e6-08.title: Neman wa malami cikin ladabi a tsawaita wa’adin aikin gida.
x-e-e6-08.goal: Kwatanta yadda buƙata ɗaya take da sauti dabam bisa mai sauraro, sannan ka sake rubuta ta a matsayin buƙata mai ladabi ga malami.
x-e-e6-08.material: Na yi rashin lafiya ranar Monday da Tuesday, saboda haka ban iya yin aikin gida ba. Ina son in tambayi malamin ajina Ms. Lee da Turanci, “Don Allah a bar ni in miƙa shi kafin Friday.” Haka kuma, ina son aron ƙwallon kwando a lokacin hutu, saboda haka zan yi buƙata iri ɗaya ga abokina Min da malamin motsa jiki Mr. Han.
x-e-e6-08.thinking.0: Zaɓen salon magana da ya dace da mai sauraro.
x-e-e6-08.thinking.1: Canza buƙata marar laushi zuwa buƙata mai ladabi tare da dalili.
x-e-e6-08.thinking.2: Bincika sassan buƙata (sunan kira, furucin buƙata, dalili).
x-e-e6-08.prereq.0: Can I / Could you ~? da please.
x-e-e6-08.prereq.1: Gaskiyar cewa kana magana dabam da aboki da malami.
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.prompt: Wace buƙata ce ta fi dacewa a aika wa Ms. Lee?

x-e-e6-08.s.s1.hint.1: Bincika ɗaya bayan ɗaya ko kowannensu yana da sunan kira, furucin buƙata, da dalili.
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.r.a: Ko da akwai please, duba ko sigar jimlar umarni ce.
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.r.b: Sanarwa ce, ba buƙata ba. Duba ko an bar wa malami damar bayar da izini.
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.r.c: Bincika ko sunan kira, furucin buƙata, da dalili duk suna tare.
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.r.d: Duba ko ana magana kamar an riga an yanke hukunci.
x-e-e6-08.s.s1.explain: Ga malami, ya kamata a yi amfani da sunan kira, tare da sigar neman izini kamar Could I ~?, da ɗan gajeren dalili. a umarni ne duk da please, b sanarwa ce maimakon buƙata, d kuma tana magana kamar ɗayan ba shi da damar ƙin amincewa.
x-e-e6-08.s.s2.prompt: Kana son aron ƙwallon kwando a lokacin hutu. Rubuta buƙata ɗaya da Turanci a layuka biyu. x-e-e6-08.s.s2.hint.1: Yi buƙatar da Could you / Would you / Can you ko please, sannan ka haɗa dalili da We have ... ko because.
x-e-e6-08.s.s2.selfAssess.0: Layin aboki da na malami suna da salon magana dabam?
